{{Quote|I'm sorry, Master Skywalker. Padmé was called away on urgent Senate business. But she left you this holo.|Moteé, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Republic 71">[[Republic 71|''Republic'' 71]]</ref>}}
'''Moteé''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] who served [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She worked alongside her fellow handmaiden, [[Ellé/Legends|Ellé]], during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] while their mistress served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

==Biography==
[[File:Moteepromofull.jpg|thumb|left|165px|Moteé, at the declaration of the Galactic Empire]]
Moteé was one of the few who were aware of Padmé's pregnancy and her secret [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|marriage]] to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], both secrets that she would never let loose. Moteé would tend to Padmé in whatever ways possible and stand in for her whenever the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] wished to meet up with her husband.<ref name="DB" />

After the [[Battle of Rendili]], Skywalker went to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] to meet with Padmé. He was instead greeted by Moteé who told him that Senator Amidala "was called away on urgent Senate business." She then gave the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] a [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] that his wife had left for him.<ref name="Republic 71" />

Moteé was present in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate rotunda]] the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] the formation of a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Like Amidala herself, Moteé was dismayed at the "thunderous applause" the new [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] received.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moteé was portrayed by Australian actress [[Kristy Wright]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="SWI71">{{InsiderCite|71|Prequel Update}}</ref>

Moteé's name appears on [[StarWars.com]] twice with alternate spellings; namely, Mote'''é''' and Mot'''é'''e.
